screen1-a1.where: The rounded blue square with a white speech bubble in it, top left, at the head of the narrow column of tiles.
screen1-a1.expectation: It takes me to my messages - probably the screen I am already on, since it is lit up blue.
screen1-a1.cue: The speech-bubble picture, the fact that it is highlighted, and the word 'Messages' printed as the heading beside it.

first_pass.why: There is no word on the tile itself. I am relying on recognising a picture, which I find hard, and on inferring from the heading next door. I think I have it right, but I have to reason it out rather than read it.
first_pass.solution: Put the word 'Messages' under the tile, as the buttons along the bottom of the profile screen do.

test_cases.targets: whether the speech-bubble square at the top left takes you where you expected
test_cases.action: From the Messages screen, press the first 'ATs' square in the left column. On that screen, press the speech-bubble square at the very top of the left column and see where you land. (one try covering the same box on screen2-a1, screen14-a1, screen26-a1, screen27-a1, screen28-a1, screen29-a1, screen30-a1, screen31-a1, screen32-a1, screen33-a1, screen34-a1, screen35-a1)
test_cases.problem_is_real_if: where you land is not what you expected, or you could not tell until you arrived
test_cases.problem_is_not_real_if: you land where you expected
test_cases.what_happened: I pressed the first 'ATs' tile, which opened the server screen, then pressed the speech-bubble square at the very top of the left column. I landed on the screen headed 'Messages'.

screen1-a1.closing_comment: I landed where I expected, and the heading confirmed it. I only knew because I remembered the tile from before; the tile itself still has no word.

screen1-a2.where: The small magnifying glass just below the 'Messages' heading, on the left.
screen1-a2.expectation: It lets me search my messages.
screen1-a2.cue: The magnifying glass, sitting directly under the 'Messages' heading.

first_pass.why: A magnifying glass meaning search is one of the few pictures I reliably know, and its position under 'Messages' tells me what it searches.

screen1-a3.where: The wide grey button with a person-and-plus picture and the words 'Add Friends', top of the screen next to the magnifying glass.
screen1-a3.expectation: It takes me to a place where I can add people as friends.
screen1-a3.cue: The words 'Add Friends' written on it.

first_pass.why: The words say exactly what it does.

screen1-a4.where: The small blue square with a white plus sign, top right, at the end of the row with 'Add Friends'.
screen1-a4.expectation: It starts something new - probably a new message, because I am on the Messages screen.
screen1-a4.cue: Only a plus sign and the 'Messages' heading above it.

first_pass.why: A plus sign just means 'add' or 'new', and this screen has several things I could add: a friend (the button right next to it already says that), a message, a group. There is another plus in the left column as well. I would read this over and over without committing.
first_pass.solution: Label it in words, for example 'New Message', so it cannot be confused with 'Add Friends' beside it or with the plus in the left column.

test_cases.targets: whether pressing the blue plus shows what it adds, and whether that differs from 'Add Friends'
test_cases.action: Start on the Messages screen (the one headed 'Messages', with the speech-bubble square at the top left). Press the blue square with the white plus at the top right (not the 'Add Friends' button). Look at what opens and read its heading. (one try covering the same box on screen2-a4, screen14-a4)
test_cases.problem_is_real_if: what opens does not tell you what the plus was for, or it is the same thing 'Add Friends' does
test_cases.problem_is_not_real_if: what opens has a heading in plain words that tells you what the plus did, and it is a different thing from 'Add Friends'
test_cases.what_happened: On the Messages screen I pressed the blue square with the white plus at the top right. A screen headed 'New Message' opened, with a 'To: Search your friends' field and an 'Add Friends' button at the bottom. So it starts a new message, which is different from 'Add Friends' and matches my first guess.

screen1-a4.closing_comment: The heading told me plainly what the plus had done, and it is not the same as 'Add Friends'. I still had to press it to find out, and the grey plus on the left turned out to mean something else entirely (creating a server), so two plus signs on one screen still cost me thought.

screen1-a5.where: The first grey rounded tile saying 'ATs' in the left column, below the speech-bubble tile.
screen1-a5.expectation: It opens something called 'ATs' - perhaps a group or server.

first_pass.why: There are three tiles that look exactly the same and all say 'ATs'. I cannot tell which is which, I do not know what 'ATs' stands for, and I cannot tell them apart by voice either - saying 'ATs' would not pick one. I would not know which to press.
first_pass.solution: Show each one's full name, and make each name different so I can tell them apart and say them aloud.
